verdict.rationale: Missive documents canned responses/templates that can be inserted with a few keystrokes instead of retyping repeated replies, shareable with teams, plus a variables templating engine for dynamic content like recipient names (missive-docs-supp-4, missive-docs-supp-5). Attachments are also natively supported in composing per general feature docs, though no explicit doc confirms attachments are saved as part of a canned response itself. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that attachments can be bundled/saved inside a canned response template, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
